subject: Jinn
text: Jinn has 6000 HP.

subject: Jinn
text: Even though Jinn is fire-based, Blizzard doesn't seem to be super-effective against him.

evidence.quote: Even though Jinn is fire-based, Blizzard doesn't seem to be super-effective against him.

subject: Jinn
text: Jinn's Flame Pillar move will deal 200+ damage to both units.

evidence.quote: Jinn's Flame Pillar move is the one you will want to watch out for. 200+ damage will be dealt to both of your units.

subject: Jinn
text: Use Mega Grenade or Thunder to deal heavy damage, and Charm Claw can poison Jinn.

evidence.quote: Use Mega Grenade or the Wizard spell, Thunder, to deal heavy damage. With the Charm Claw, you can poison Jinn.

subject: Medusa
text: Medusa has 7000 HP.

subject: Medusa
text: White deals a lot of damage, and only a few castings are needed to put Medusa down.

evidence.quote: White deals a lot of damage. Only a few castings are needed to put her down.

subject: Medusa
text: Medusa's Screech Voice is capable of confusing a unit, Stone Voice can petrify, and Para-snake can paralyze.

evidence.quote: Beware of her Screech Voice move; it's capable of confusing a unit. Stone Voice can petrify and Para-snake can paralyze.

subject: Dualhead Hydra
text: Dualhead Hydra has 14000 HP.

subject: Dualhead Hydra
text: The White spell will deal a considerable amount of damage to the Dualhead Hydra.

evidence.quote: The White spell will be your salvation in this battle. Although you obviously can't cast it forever, it still will deal a considerable amount of damage to the Dualhead Hydra.

subject: Dualhead Hydra
text: Dualhead Hydra's Para-Breath and Poison Breath paralyze and poison, while Stone Gas will petrify.

evidence.quote: Para-Breath and Poison Breath will paralyze and poison, respectively. Stone Gas will petrify.

subject: Moon Helm
text: A Moon Helm can help defend against Fire Breath.

evidence.quote: Although a Moon Helm can help defend against Fire Breath, Reuben (without any fire protection) will surely be fried.

subject: Gidrah
text: Gidrah has 13000 HP.

subject: Gidrah
text: Benjamin can use Meteor or White while Kaeli blasts Gidrah with Aero.

evidence.quote: Once they are cleared out, have Benjamin use Meteor or White while Kaeli continues to blast Gidrah with Aero.

subject: Gidrah
text: Gidrah can paralyze and petrify your team.

evidence.quote: Gidrah can paralyze and petrify your team, so watch out for those.

subject: Dullahan
text: Dullahan has 14000 HP.

subject: Dullahan
text: The best way to defeat Dullahan is by casting Meteor and White.

evidence.quote: The best way to defeat Dullahan is through pounding him with magic. That means casting Meteor, White, etc.

subject: Dullahan
text: Dullahan's Doom Dance is capable of automatically killing one of your units regardless of their HP.

evidence.quote: The one move you want to watch out for is Doom Dance. It is capable of automatically killing one of your units regardless of their HP.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu has 25000 HP.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu is weak against wind attacks, so Aero works wonders, though Flare deals more damage.

evidence.quote: The birdman is weak against wind attacks, so Aero works wonders. Flare deals more damage though.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Psychshield makes it so attacking Pazuzu while it is up triggers a nasty counter-attack.

evidence.quote: Psychshield makes it so that if you attack Pazuzu while it is up, you will eat a nasty counter-attack. Do not attack with his shield up for that very reason.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Against Pazuzu, Aero deals 1500+ damage while Flare can deal 2000+ damage.

evidence.quote: Aero (assuming Kaeli casts it) deals 1500+ damage while Flare can deal 2000+ damage.

subject: Skullrus Rex
text: Skullrus Rex has 10000 HP.

subject: Skullrus Rex
text: Dealing 2000+ damage with Flare and White allows you to defeat Skullrus Rex within 2.5 turns.

evidence.quote: Upon taking down the Shadows, begin pounding the Skullrus Rex with Flare (Benjamin) and White (Phoebe). If you can deal 2000+ damage with each move, the Skullrus Rex will die within 2.5 turns.

subject: Skullrus Rex
text: Skullrus Rex uses Sleep Powder, but Benjamin cannot be put to sleep.

evidence.quote: The only move you will want to watch out for is Sleep Powder. Luckily, Benjamin can't be put to sleep.

subject: Stone Golem
text: Stone Golem has 10000 HP.

subject: Stone Golem
text: Two Cerberus enemies accompany Stone Golem and can use Doom Gaze for an instant KO.

evidence.quote: Two Cerberus's accompany the Stone Golem in all of his... well... stoniness! The faster you take care of them, the better. You don't want Doom Gaze (instant KO) to get the best of you before you even begin to fight the Stone Golem.

subject: Stone Golem
text: Stone Golem is strong against Flare and Meteor spells.

evidence.quote: Don't use Flare or Meteor or the Stone Golem is strong against those two spells.

subject: Twinhead Wyvern
text: Twinhead Wyvern has 15000 HP.

subject: Twinhead Wyvern
text: Twinhead Wyvern is strong against flame-based spells like Flare or Fire, so use Meteor or White instead.

evidence.quote: Do not use Flare or Fire in this fight. The Twinhead Wyvern is strong against flame-based spells. Instead, use Meteor or White.

subject: Zuh
text: Zuh has 20000 HP.

subject: Zuh
text: Zuh, Chimera, and Thanatos allies are weak to Aero.

evidence.quote: Begin the fight by killing off his Chimera and Thanatos allies. Luckily for you, all three of your enemies are weak to Aero.

subject: Zuh
text: Do not attack Zuh while Psychshield is up.

evidence.quote: Be wary of the Psychshield. When it's up, DO NOT attack unless you want to die young.

subject: Zuh
text: Repeatedly using Flare and White allows you to win against Zuh.

evidence.quote: To win, all you really have to do is repeatedly use Flare and White.

subject: Dark King
text: Dark King has 40000 HP.

subject: Dark King
text: When Dark King mocks you, he grows new arms armed with dangerous weapons.

evidence.quote: When he starts to mock you (he'll actually say something), the Dark King will grow some new arms. Each of them is armed with a dangerous weapon.

subject: Dark King
text: Phoebe should heal while Benjamin casts Flare to deal about 2000 HP damage every turn.

evidence.quote: I would just give Phoebe the role of healer now while Benjamin blasts away with Flare...deal about 2000 HP damage every turn at the least.

subject: Dark King
text: In spider form, watch out for Dark King's Mega Flare and Laser.

evidence.quote: Yeah, he turns into a spider...watch out for Mega Flare and Laser.

subject: Dark King
text: In his final octopus form, a few more Flares will defeat the Dark King while Phoebe heals.

evidence.quote: At long lasts, he'll finally transform into his final form; an octopussy-looking thing. Have Phoebe continue to heal the two. A few more Flares will finally put the Dark King in his place.
